say:1:1523633001:0.text: The flood victims are in bad shape... Many of them are hungry, and some have fallen ill.
say:1:1523633001:0.source_cn: 洪水中失去家的难民们基本都被救上来了，但他们的状态还是...
say:1:1523633001:0.male: The flood victims are in bad shape... Many of them are hungry, and some have fallen ill.
say:1:1523633001:0.female: The flood victims are in bad shape... Many of them are hungry, and some have fallen ill.

say:2:1523633002:1.text: The thing is, I don't have enough hands to care for them. All the guards are busy repairing the city and cleaning up the flood debris.
say:2:1523633002:1.source_cn: 可现在卫兵忙着重修城邦、清理洪水，都说实在抽不出人手再...
say:2:1523633002:1.male: The thing is, I don't have enough hands to care for them. All the guards are busy repairing the city and cleaning up the flood debris.
say:2:1523633002:1.female: The thing is, I don't have enough hands to care for them. All the guards are busy repairing the city and cleaning up the flood debris.

say:3:1523633003:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you <style="highlight">check on the flood victims and give them a hand</style>?

say:3:1523633003:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you <style="highlight">check on the flood victims and give them a hand</style>?

say:2:1523634002:1.text: I'm burning up... Am I... going to die?
say:2:1523634002:1.source_cn: 身体好烫……我是不是……要死了……？
say:2:1523634002:1.male: I'm burning up... Am I... going to die?
say:2:1523634002:1.female: I'm burning up... Am I... going to die?

say:4:1523634003:1.text: I can't find any medicine... I... I'm not ready to die.
say:4:1523634003:1.source_cn: 没有药……哪里都没有。我，我不想死啊……
say:4:1523634003:1.male: I can't find any medicine... I... I'm not ready to die.
say:4:1523634003:1.female: I can't find any medicine... I... I'm not ready to die.

say:1:1523635001:0.text: Why... Why won't he open his eyes...
say:1:1523635001:0.source_cn: 我的孩子，我的孩子……他为什么睁不开眼睛了……
say:1:1523635001:0.male: Why... Why won't he open his eyes...
say:1:1523635001:0.female: Why... Why won't he open his eyes...

say:2:1523635002:1.text: Open your eyes, my dear... Look at Mommy... Please don't leave me...
say:2:1523635002:1.source_cn: 快醒醒……快睁开眼睛，睁开眼睛看看妈妈……不，不要走……

choice_prompt:3:1523635002.text: Open your eyes, my dear... Look at Mommy... Please don't leave me...

say:4:1523635003:1.text: Are you... a healer? You must have some medicine, right? Please save my boy!
say:4:1523635003:1.source_cn: 您……您是医生吗？您一定有药对不对？求求您，求求您给我...
say:4:1523635003:1.male: Are you... a healer? You must have some medicine, right? Please save my boy!
say:4:1523635003:1.female: Are you... a healer? You must have some medicine, right? Please save my boy!

choice:3:0:1.text: I'll take a look at the boy.
choice:3:0:1.male: I'll take a look at the boy.
choice:3:0:1.female: I'll take a look at the boy.

choice:3:1:2.text: He's alive, but his condition is critical.

choice:3:1:2.female: He's alive, but his condition is critical.

say:0:1523636001:0.text: The flood victims are gravely ill and need medicine.
say:0:1523636001:0.source_cn: 难民们病得厉害，需要药物进行治疗。
say:0:1523636001:0.male: The flood victims are gravely ill and need medicine.
say:0:1523636001:0.female: The flood victims are gravely ill and need medicine.

say:1:1523636002:0.text: Let's gather ingredients and prepare potions for them.
say:1:1523636002:0.source_cn: 去收集一些材料，为他们调制治疗药剂吧。
say:1:1523636002:0.male: Let's gather ingredients and prepare potions for them.
say:1:1523636002:0.female: Let's gather ingredients and prepare potions for them.

document:0:367:0.text:
Appearance: Light green, clear liquid.
Effect: Healing potion for fevers caused by hypothermia, infection, or other illnesses.
Preparation: Add <style="highlight">violet veilleaf</style> and <style="highlight">velorind plant</style>, simmer until fully dissolved.
document:0:367:0.source_cn:
性状：浅绿色药剂，质地清澈水状
药效：治疗药剂，可治疗因失温、感染等原因引起的发烧。
炼制方法：依次加入<style="highlight">安宁紫叶</style>、<style="highlight">圣白缬草</style>，熬煮至所有药材融化后即可制成。

say:0:1523639001:0.text: I still feel a bit groggy, but much better than before!
say:0:1523639001:0.source_cn: 虽然还是有些昏昏沉沉的……但感觉比刚刚好多了！
say:0:1523639001:0.male: I still feel a bit groggy, but much better than before!
say:0:1523639001:0.female: I still feel a bit groggy, but much better than before!

say:1:1523639002:0.source_cn: 谢谢您，好心的医生，谢谢！

say:1:1523640002:0.source_cn: 我的孩子……你醒了，终于醒了……

say:0:1523640101:0.text: The flood victims are recovering. Inform Abundius of the latest situation.
say:0:1523640101:0.source_cn: 难民的问题暂时解决了，将这里的情况告诉阿邦德吧。
say:0:1523640101:0.male: The flood victims are recovering. Inform Abundius of the latest situation.
say:0:1523640101:0.female: The flood victims are recovering. Inform Abundius of the latest situation.

say:1:1523640201:0.text: So many of the victims have fallen ill... Good thing you stepped in. If the disease had spread, Halia might have faced another disaster.
say:1:1523640201:0.source_cn: 竟然有这么多难民生病……还好有你帮忙，要是拖到疾病传播...
say:1:1523640201:0.male: So many of the victims have fallen ill... Good thing you stepped in. If the disease had spread, Halia might have faced another disaster.
say:1:1523640201:0.female: So many of the victims have fallen ill... Good thing you stepped in. If the disease had spread, Halia might have faced another disaster.
